001package dayplanner;
002
003import java.awt.BorderLayout;
004import java.awt.Color;
005import java.awt.Component;
006import java.awt.Dimension;
007import java.awt.GridLayout;
008import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
009import java.awt.event.ActionListener;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011
012import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
013import javax.swing.Box;
014import javax.swing.BoxLayout;
015import javax.swing.JButton;
016import javax.swing.JFrame;
017import javax.swing.JLabel;
018import javax.swing.JPanel;
019import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
020import javax.swing.JTextArea;
021import javax.swing.JTextField;
022import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;

024
025/**
026 * Abstract superclass representing a standard DayPlanner GUI window (such as
027 * Add or Search).
028 */
029public abstract class GUIWindow extends JFrame {
030    /**
031     * Default dimensions of the GUI window.
032     */
033    private static final Dimension DIMS = new Dimension(800, 600);
034
035    /**
036     * Default close operation: dispose this window when closed.
037     */
038    private static final int CLOSE = JFrame.DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE;
039
040    /**
041     * Background color for the GUI window content pane.
042     */
043    private static final Color BACKGROUND = new Color(250, 250, 250);
044
045    /**
046     * Padding border applied around panels in the window.
047     */
048    private static final Border PADDING = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(12, 12, 12, 12);
049
050    /**
051     * Reference to the activity list.
052     */
053    public ActivityList activities;
054
055    /**
056     * ArrayList that contains all of the JTextField instances in the center panel.
057     */
058    public ArrayList<JTextField> centerFields = new ArrayList<JTextField>();
059
060    /**
061     * Message box text area.
062     */
063    public JTextArea messages = null;
064
065    /**
066     * Scroll pane containing the message box.
067     */
068    public JScrollPane scrollPane = null;
069
070    /**
071     * The reset button.
072     */
073    public JButton resetButton = null;
074
075    /**
076     * The primary action button (e.g. Add or Search).
077     */
078    public JButton actionButton = null;
079
080    /**
081     * Creates and initializes a new Swing GUI window.
082     * 
083     * @param activities Instantiated ActivityList.
084     */
085    public GUIWindow(ActivityList activities) {
086        super();
087        this.activities = activities;
088
089        setSize(DIMS);
090        setTitle(getWindowTitle());
091        setDefaultCloseOperation(CLOSE);
092        getContentPane().setBackground(BACKGROUND);
093        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
094        setLayout(new BorderLayout(12, 12));
095
096        add(createCenterPanel(), BorderLayout.CENTER);
097        add(createEastPanel(), BorderLayout.EAST);
098        add(createSouthPanel(), BorderLayout.SOUTH);
099        setVisible(true);
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * Creates the center form panel containing input fields.
104     * 
105     * @return Initialized JPanel for center region.
106     */
107    public JPanel createCenterPanel() {
108        String[] labels = getFieldLabels();
109        int rows = labels.length + 2; // +2 for the header rows
110
111        JPanel centerPanel = new JPanel();
112        centerPanel.setLayout(new GridLayout(rows, 2, 8, 8));
113        centerPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
114        centerPanel.add(new JLabel(getHeaderText()));
115        centerPanel.add(Box.createGlue()); // skip this grid cell
116        centerPanel.add(new JLabel(getSubHeaderText()));
117        centerPanel.add(Box.createGlue()); // skip this grid cell
118
119        centerFields.clear();
120        for (String labelText : labels) {
121            centerPanel.add(new JLabel(labelText));
122            JTextField tf = new JTextField();
123            centerPanel.add(tf);
124            centerFields.add(tf);
125        }
126
127        return centerPanel;
128    }
129
130    /**
131     * Creates the east panel containing action buttons.
132     * 
133     * @return Initialized JPanel for east region.
134     */
135    public JPanel createEastPanel() {
136        JPanel eastPanel = new JPanel();
137        eastPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
138        eastPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(eastPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
139
140        ActionListener buttonEvent = new ActionListener() {
141            @Override
142            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent event) {
143                String action = event.getActionCommand();
144                if ("RESET".equals(action)) {
145                    resetFields();
146                } else if (getActionButtonCommand().equals(action)) {
147                    executeAction();
148                }
149            }
150        };
151
152        resetButton = new JButton("Reset");
153        resetButton.setActionCommand("RESET");
154        resetButton.addActionListener(buttonEvent);
155        eastPanel.add(resetButton);
156
157        actionButton = new JButton(getActionButtonLabel());
158        actionButton.setActionCommand(getActionButtonCommand());
159        actionButton.addActionListener(buttonEvent);
160        eastPanel.add(actionButton);
161
162        return eastPanel;
163    }
164
165    /**
166     * Creates the south panel containing the message log display.
167     * 
168     * @return Initialized JPanel for south region.
169     */
170    public JPanel createSouthPanel() {
171        JPanel southPanel = new JPanel();
172        southPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(southPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
173        southPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
174
175        JLabel messageLabel = new JLabel("<html><b>Messages:</b></html>");
176        messageLabel.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
177        southPanel.add(messageLabel);
178        southPanel.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(6));
179
180        messages = new JTextArea(5, 40);
181        messages.setEditable(false);
182        messages.setLineWrap(true);
183        messages.setWrapStyleWord(true);
184        messages.setBackground(Color.WHITE);
185
186        scrollPane = new JScrollPane(messages);
187        scrollPane.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED);
188        scrollPane.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER);
189        scrollPane.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(760, 100));
190        scrollPane.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 110));
191        scrollPane.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
192        southPanel.add(scrollPane);
193
194        return southPanel;
195    }
196
197    /**
198     * Resets all text input fields in the center panel.
199     */
200    public void resetFields() {
201        if (centerFields != null) {
202            for (JTextField tf : centerFields) {
203                tf.setText(null);
204            }
205        }
206    }
207
208    /**
209     * Add a message to the top of the message box and scroll to the top.
210     * Does nothing if the text box hasn't been initialized yet or if the text is blank.
211     * 
212     * @param text Text to add.
213     */
214    public void addMessage(String text) {
215        if (messages == null || text == null || text.isBlank())
216            return;
217
218        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
219        sb.append("> ");
220        sb.append(text);
221        if (!messages.getText().isEmpty()) {
222            sb.append("\n");
223            sb.append(messages.getText());
224        }
225
226        messages.setText(sb.toString());
227        messages.setCaretPosition(0);
228        if (scrollPane != null) {
229            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
230                scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
231            });
232        }
233    }
234
235    /**
236     * Validates and parses a required time string using
237     * {@link Input#parseTime(String)} and
238     * {@link Time#getValidationError(int, int, int, int, int)}.
239     * 
240     * @param timeStr   Raw time string from user input.
241     * @param fieldName Display name of the field (e.g. "Starting time").
242     * @return Parsed {@link Time} instance, or {@code null} if invalid (with error
243     *         added to messages).
244     */
245    public Time parseAndValidateTime(String timeStr, String fieldName) {
246        return parseAndValidateTime(timeStr, fieldName, true);
247    }
248
249    /**
250     * Validates and parses a time string with optional requirement check.
251     * 
252     * @param timeStr   Raw time string from user input.
253     * @param fieldName Display name of the field (e.g. "Starting time").
254     * @param required  Whether the field is required. If false and input is blank,
255     *                  returns null without error.
256     * @return Parsed {@link Time} instance, or {@code null} if invalid or empty.
257     */
258    public Time parseAndValidateTime(String timeStr, String fieldName, boolean required) {
259        if (timeStr == null || timeStr.isBlank()) {
260            if (required)
261                addMessage(fieldName + " cannot be empty. Expected format: YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM.");
262            return null;
263        }
264
265        Time time = Input.parseTime(timeStr);
266        if (time != null)
267            return time;
268
269        String[] components = timeStr.trim().split("[/:,\\s]+");
270        if (components.length < 5) {
271            addMessage("Invalid " + fieldName.toLowerCase() + " format. Expected: YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM (e.g. 2026/09/10 17:30).");
272            return null;
273        }
274
275        try {
276            int y = Integer.parseInt(components[0]);
277            int m = Integer.parseInt(components[1]);
278            int d = Integer.parseInt(components[2]);
279            int h = Integer.parseInt(components[3]);
280            int min = Integer.parseInt(components[4]);
281
282            return new Time(y, m, d, h, min);
283        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
284            addMessage(fieldName + " components must be integers.");
285        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
286            addMessage("Invalid " + fieldName.toLowerCase() + ": " + e.getMessage());
287        }
288
289        return null;
290    }
291
292    /**
293     * Gets the associated ActivityList.
294     * 
295     * @return The ActivityList instance.
296     */
297    public ActivityList getActivities() {
298        return activities;
299    }
300
301    /**
302     * Gets the list of text fields in the center panel.
303     * 
304     * @return ArrayList of JTextFields.
305     */
306    public ArrayList<JTextField> getCenterFields() {
307        return centerFields;
308    }
309
310    /**
311     * Gets the messages text area.
312     * 
313     * @return JTextArea instance.
314     */
315    public JTextArea getMessages() {
316        return messages;
317    }
318
319    /**
320     * Gets the scroll pane for messages.
321     * 
322     * @return JScrollPane instance.
323     */
324    public JScrollPane getScrollPane() {
325        return scrollPane;
326    }
327
328    /**
329     * Gets the reset button.
330     * 
331     * @return JButton instance.
332     */
333    public JButton getResetButton() {
334        return resetButton;
335    }
336
337    /**
338     * Gets the action button.
339     * 
340     * @return JButton instance.
341     */
342    public JButton getActionButton() {
343        return actionButton;
344    }
345
346    /**
347     * Returns the title for this window.
348     * 
349     * @return Window title string.
350     */
351    public abstract String getWindowTitle();
352
353    /**
354     * Returns the header HTML text shown at the top of the form.
355     * 
356     * @return Header label text.
357     */
358    public abstract String getHeaderText();
359
360    /**
361     * Returns the subheader HTML text shown under the header.
362     * 
363     * @return Subheader label text.
364     */
365    public abstract String getSubHeaderText();
366
367    /**
368     * Returns the display text for the primary action button.
369     * 
370     * @return Action button label.
371     */
372    public abstract String getActionButtonLabel();
373
374    /**
375     * Returns the action command string for the primary action button.
376     * 
377     * @return Action button command string.
378     */
379    public abstract String getActionButtonCommand();
380
381    /**
382     * Returns the labels for each form field in the center panel.
383     * 
384     * @return Array of label strings.
385     */
386    public abstract String[] getFieldLabels();
387
388    /**
389     * Executes the primary action when the action button is clicked.
390     * 
391     * @return true if action succeeded, false otherwise.
392     */
393    public abstract boolean executeAction();
394}
